_README: User-tunable knobs for the Messenger appliance. Missing/invalid fields fall back to built-in defaults (see app_config.py) — the app still starts. Security-perimeter settings (which HOSTS may hold permissions, which URL schemes are allowed) live in trusted_origins.py on purpose, not here. With dev_mode on, the console logs every externalised navigation and dropped popup, so you can see what to tune.

navigation._note: facebook.com PATH prefixes that stay in-app (segment-boundary matched: /login matches /login and /login/... but NOT /login.evil or /helpful). Everything else on facebook.com opens in your real browser; the bare / feed is bounced to /messages. If a login step gets kicked out to the browser, watch the [nav] log and add the exact path to facebook_auth_prefixes.

telemetry_filter._note: Drops Facebook background beacon/logging traffic to cut the resource drain. Ships DISABLED because it hasn't been verified against a live authenticated session — turn it on (enabled: true) only after you've confirmed login, messaging, attachments, and voice/video calls all still work. host "" matches any host; path is a plain prefix. Over-blocking breaks chat.

chrome_filter._note: CSS selectors hidden on the MESSAGES page only (each applied as 'selector { display: none !important }'), plus gesture-aware autoplay pausing (autoplay is paused; video you click to play is left alone). The injected script self-gates to facebook.com messaging paths, so login/checkpoint/settings are never touched. Prefer stable role/aria selectors; use dev_mode Inspect Element to find more.
